name: Facet
text: Implement a single dark theme by default with a manual toggle to light mode. This maximizes visual clarity and reduces eye strain for extended use, aligning with our goal of liveliness and clarity. The trade-off is that light mode users must manually switch, but the default dark theme ensures optimal readability for the majority. This matches our competitive analysis and Graphify Dashboard’s proven approach.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t user preference—it’s locking ourselves into a theme system before we know how users actually engage with the interface. A better alternative is a system-aware default: dark mode for low-light contexts, light mode for high-light, with a manual override. Settle it by testing both against task completion speed and error rates in controlled sessions.
